english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying that there are many of something.
Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for a large quantity of things, such as abundant fruit or supplies.
Use this when “immense” means a large quantity or number rather than physical size.

examples.english: This shop has numerous kinds of cakes.
examples.traditional: 呢間舖頭有好多款蛋糕。
examples.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 jau5 hou2 do1 fun2 daan6 gou1

examples.english: There is abundant fruit at the market today.
examples.traditional: 今日個街市有好多水果。
examples.jyutping: gam1 jat6 go3 gaai1 si5 jau5 hou2 do1 seoi2 gwo2

examples.english: We need an immense amount of money for this trip.
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 jiu3 jung6 hou2 do1 cin4
